fields.text:
ONE ENTRY IS ONE MONTHLY UPDATE. SQF 2.1.2.2 asks the SQF Practitioner to update senior site management at least monthly on matters affecting the SQF System, and for the update AND management's response to be documented. This is that record.

IT IS DELIBERATELY SHORT. Twelve of these a year only get filled in if filling one in takes minutes. Most months several rows will read "none", and that is a complete answer - a row saying nothing arose is evidence the question was asked.

MOST OF SECTION 2 IS ALREADY ON THE NOTIFICATIONS PAGE. Verification activities that have fallen due, open alerts and outstanding items are listed there; this record is where what was said about them, and what management decided, gets written down.

THE ANNUAL REVIEW IS A DIFFERENT RECORD. The full review of the SQF System against the six items 2.1.2.1 names is recorded on FRM-001, once a year. This form does not replace it.
fields.label: How this record works

fields.text: Answer every row, including with "none". A blank row cannot be told apart from one nobody raised.
fields.label: How to fill this in

labels:
Verification activities due or overdue
What the schedule shows outstanding, and why.

Open corrective actions

Complaints, incidents and recalls
Anything raised since the last update.

Audit and inspection findings
Internal, customer, certification body or regulatory.

Changes affecting the SQF System
Process, product, equipment, facility or personnel.
Anything needing a decision or a resource

fields.help: What senior site management said about the matters above, and what was decided.
fields.label: Response and decisions

fields.help: Leave empty where nothing was actioned.
fields.label: Actions arising

fields.text:
BOTH SIGNATURES ARE THE POINT OF THE RECORD. 2.1.2.2 asks for the update and the response - the SQF Practitioner signs that the update was given, senior site management signs its response to it. Where one person holds both posts, they sign both and the record shows it as it is.

Only admin/owner can sign the management line. If that is not you, fill this in, save it as a draft and use Request signature to send it to whoever signs.
